purpose: Define composition rules between command, input, adapter and view module types so combined features preserve each type's authority/effect boundary instead of collapsing them into one ambiguous module behavior.

topics.name: UserModule Type Composition
topics.purpose: Define composition rules between command, input, adapter and view module types so combined features preserve each type's authority/effect boundary instead of collapsing them into one ambiguous module behavior.

semantics.composition_rule: A feature may compose multiple typed modules, but each constituent retains its declared type boundary.
semantics.input_command_rule: Input may request/emit Event leading to a command, but input payload does not directly inherit command authority.
semantics.adapter_rule: Adapter may expose command/input symbols but does not become their semantic owner.
semantics.view_rule: View may invoke commands through explicit authorized operations but remains UI-only.
semantics.identity_rule: Composite feature identity does not erase constituent module identities.

invariants.rule: Command, input, adapter and view module types have distinct effect boundaries: command is one-shot operation, input writes declared instance data, adapter mounts/translates symbols without owning them, and view is UI-only.

hard_gates.condition: composite module erases constituent type boundaries
view gains mutation authority by composition
